meta.title: Repp · The gym app to log your workouts
meta.description: Log every set, rank up in every muscle and keep your streak alive. The gym workout tracker for iPhone and Android, free to start.

hero.subtitle: Log every set, rank up in every muscle and keep your streak alive.

log.label: Logging
log.title: Log every set in seconds.
log.text: Weight, reps and rest, with what you did last time right there. Offline too.
log.visual: Logging a workout in Repp: sets with weight, reps and rest

ranks.label: Ranks
ranks.title: Rank up in every muscle.
ranks.text: From Iron to Repp Elite, for every exercise and every muscle. See how strong you really are and compare with friends.

coach.title: A program built for you.

habit.label: Streaks and challenges
habit.title: Don't break the streak.
habit.text: Count your training weeks, keep them on a home-screen widget and challenge a friend to beat your workout.
habit.visual: Repp's streak widget and a one-on-one challenge

trainer.title: Are you a trainer?
trainer.text: Build routines and plans in Repp Coach and your clients see them in their Repp app.

items.a: Yes. You log unlimited workouts and save up to 4 routines for free. Repp Pro is optional: unlimited routines, automatic progressive overload, saving your Coach program and advanced stats.
Yes. You start and finish your workout with no signal, and it uploads itself once you're back online.

Every exercise you train gets a rank, from Iron to Repp Elite, based on the weight and reps you do (and your bodyweight for bodyweight exercises). Your muscle ranks and your Repp Rank come from there.
You challenge someone to beat your workout, one on one, and pick the deadline. It settles itself as soon as your rival finishes theirs.

items.q: Is it on iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes, on the App Store and Google Play.

items.q: Can I train with my coach?
items.a: Yes. If your trainer uses Repp Coach, they add you and their plan shows up in your Workouts.
